description: This file defines the ForbiddenController class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The class is responsible for handling forbidden access scenarios by rendering an 'auth-forbidden' Vue component. It extends a base Vue controller and implements a public interface, indicating it provides functionality accessible without authentication. The core method preRender sets up the component to be rendered when the associated route or request is accessed.

classes.name: ForbiddenController
classes.description: Handles the forbidden access scenario by rendering the 'auth-forbidden' component. Extends AbstractVueController and implements PublicControllerInterface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component to be displayed when access is forbidden by creating a new Component with the identifier 'auth-forbidden' and assigning it to the controller.
